findings.location: Engagement section, paragraph beginning “Through all this”
findings.source_quote: “A young couple should not fully give their hearts to each other until marriage.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Wanandoa wachanga hawapaswi kupeana mioyo yao kikamilifu kabla ya ndoa” with “Wawili walio katika uchumba hawapaswi kupeana mioyo yao kikamilifu kabla ya ndoa.”
findings.translation_quote: “Wanandoa wachanga hawapaswi kupeana mioyo yao kikamilifu kabla ya ndoa.”

findings.location: “How does a young man know…” paragraph; “Guidelines…” opening paragraph
findings.source_quote: “a virtuous young woman is valued far above rubies”; “Her price is ‘far above rubies.’”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “marijani” with a Kiswahili term for rubies, such as “yakuti nyekundu,” in both places.
findings.translation_quote: “mwanamke kijana mwenye tabia njema ana thamani kubwa kuliko marijani”; “Thamani yake ni ‘kubwa kuliko marijani.’”

findings.source_quote: “a chaperone should be along to abstain from all appearances of evil.”
findings.suggested_fix: Render “appearances of evil” as “mambo yanayoweza kuonekana kuwa maovu” rather than “kila namna ya uovu.”
findings.translation_quote: “mwandamani anapaswa kuwapo ili kuepuka kila namna ya uovu.”

findings.source_quote: “This should be planned soon if the rest of the family doesn’t know about it yet.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “familia nyingine” with “wanafamilia wengine” to refer to other members of the family.
findings.translation_quote: “Hili linapaswa kupangwa hivi karibuni ikiwa familia nyingine bado haijui jambo hili.”

findings.suggested_fix: Replace “mnapoondoka kwenye sherehe ya harusi yenu” with “mnapomaliza siku yenu ya harusi” to retain the source’s reference to the wedding day.
findings.translation_quote: “Mungu anatamani kuwabariki mnapoondoka kwenye sherehe ya harusi yenu.”
